items.a: Yes! Jobvero offers a forever-free plan with essential job search features. Upgrade to Pro or Premium anytime to unlock unlimited AI matching, cover letters, interview prep, and more.
Jobvero is fully available in English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese — with more languages on the roadmap.

items.q: How does AI job matching work?
items.a: Our AI analyzes your resume, skills, and job preferences to score and rank thousands of listings — surfacing only the most relevant opportunities so you spend less time searching and more time applying.
Absolutely. Your data is encrypted end-to-end and is never sold to third parties. Jobvero is fully GDPR-compliant and you can delete your account at any time.

items.q: Can I use Jobvero if I'm changing careers?
items.a: Yes! Jobvero is built for career changers. Our AI identifies your transferable skills and highlights roles where your background becomes a competitive advantage, even in a new field.
